pack f f f f f f

A Vizzie module/abstraction that uses a Navier-Stokes attractor to generate data. The Navier–Stokes equations describe the motion of viscous fluid substances, and are used extensively in video games in order to model natural phenomena such as fire and smoke. The module splits out portions of the equation (the first five outlets) and a sum/average (the sixth outlet) to let you produce nonlinear data outputs with a "human" feel.
